name: Shishidou Asuka
source:
"If you can do it, then please try. I'll look forward to it, Asuma Hayato-kun."

A second-year student.

Asuka was elected as the student council president in her first year. Now in her sophomore year, she handles the council's responsibilities single-handedly. Her excellent grades and motor skills have always put her at the top of her class.

Her captivating looks have made her popular among the male students, leading her to be perceived as a flower on a high peak, an unattainable gem, and earning her the nickname "Ice Princess."

Asuka forms an unexpected connection with the protagonist, Asuma Hayato, due to a light-hearted mix-up involving their similar-sounding names, "Asuma" and "Asuka." As a result, she invites Hayato to participate in student council activities under the guise of monitoring his actions.

Despite her many accomplishments, she isn't good at socializing with others, nor does she imagine herself falling in love.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/asunabi/character.html]Official website[/url]]
